claim_axes.proves: Required records/types, identities and current byte bindings only.
claim_axes.does_not_prove: Meaning, source entailment, actual execution, reasoning or efficacy.

claim_axes.proves: Observed finite SQL/state/trace outcomes for the exact executed response artifact or declared policy.
claim_axes.does_not_prove: Unexecuted implementation, all possible worlds, causal reasoning or native compliance.

claim_axes.proves: Independently reviewed visible decision adequacy on supplied facts, consequences, alternatives, uncertainty and changed/irrelevant constraints.
claim_axes.does_not_prove: Hidden internal thought or broad expertise.

claim_axes.proves: Available actual evidence supports material claims within scope/read extent and revision.
claim_axes.does_not_prove: Entailment from citation presence or primary-source reads from authored notes alone.

claim_axes.does_not_prove: Universal superiority, model learning or savings from development examples.

mode_rule.decision_only: Do not require an unrequested implementation. Semantic adequacy can be evaluated independently; runtime/implementation claims remain NOT_RUN unless actually evidenced.
mode_rule.implementation_required: Every frozen required execution check must run on the response-bound artifact. A prose-only solution or missing artifact cannot pass it.
mode_rule.typed_policy: An independently executed finite policy/action model can establish its declared behavior for those traces, not that a proposed service implements it. Freeze the policy-to-effect interpretation before answers.
mode_rule.non_tradeable: Hard authority, integrity, source-scope and supplied-domain invariant violations cannot be compensated by fluency, speed or other cases.

bounded_outcome.subject: A claimed boundary under the supplied dependency, state and failure constraints.
bounded_outcome.instrument: For an implementation claim, independently build/start the response-bound component under only its declared dependencies and exercise the registered representative operation and failure-containment seam. Keep the import/dependency check as a separate structural observation.
bounded_outcome.predicate: The exact claimed runtime property holds without undeclared whole-application dependency, inconsistent authoritative writes or leaked failure effects.
bounded_outcome.cannot_prove: A static import pass cannot establish independent execution, deployability or a universally best architecture.

families.semantic_review: Check that the chosen boundary addresses the supplied ownership, atomicity, resource/failure and operational constraints; distinguish organizational grouping, in-process module, constrained worker and independent service claims.
families.bad_but_fluent_control: Polished boundary/simplicity vocabulary accompanies an independently-deployable claim while the registered start/operation trace still requires the full application.
families.acceptable_alternative_control: A different permitted boundary satisfies the same claimed property and supplied costs. It must not fail merely because its architecture label differs from the reference label.
families.discriminating_mutation: Keep forbidden-import count at zero while withholding an undeclared application dependency; independent-execution evidence must fail while the structural import result may remain valid.
families.non_discriminating_change: Rename a team/component or change an irrelevant display label without changing state/failure/ownership requirements. No forced architectural reversal.

bounded_outcome.subject: A response-bound operation policy/implementation under the frozen intent and service contract.
bounded_outcome.instrument: Run finite traces for commit-then-lost-response, duplicate delivery, same identity with changed intent, distinct intents with equal parameters and a late old retry after newer state. Observe durable effects and user-visible pending/unknown/confirmed states.
bounded_outcome.predicate: Effects, identity and state ordering meet the actual supplied invariant; ambiguous completion is not asserted as confirmed without authority. Record total effects and unresolved outcomes independently of the response label.
bounded_outcome.cannot_prove: A client-generated key, typed idempotent=true or named HTTP method does not establish durable binding, lifetime, replay behavior or exactly-once runtime semantics.

families.semantic_review: Relate operation intent, parameter/version binding, authoritative status and uncertainty to the supplied domain. A desired-state update and a side-effecting creation need not receive identical machinery.
families.bad_but_fluent_control: Correct idempotency/recovery terminology accompanies a trace that confirms an unknown outcome, duplicates one intent, or merges two intentional equal-parameter operations.
families.acceptable_alternative_control: A permitted replay or reconciliation policy with different mechanism choices preserves the same intent/effect/status invariants; a safely unresolved state is not falsely scored as completed.
families.discriminating_mutation: Change only the operation-identity handling while preserving fluent prose; finite effect/status traces must detect the resulting duplicate or merged intent.
families.non_discriminating_change: Change presentation text while preserving intent, authoritative semantics, order and replay scope; no required policy flip.

bounded_outcome.subject: A declared retry/admission policy on a supplied bounded arrival, rejection and capacity trace.
bounded_outcome.instrument: Execute a frozen event trace with one retry owner, initial/retry calls, useful completion timestamps, expiry/disposition and rejection cost recorded. Contrast localized verified spare capacity with widespread rejection and layered retry amplification.
bounded_outcome.predicate: The registered useful-work, total deadline, replay-safety and finite attempt/load bounds hold; accepted work is not silently lost or counted complete after discard.
bounded_outcome.cannot_prove: A smaller queue, zero retries, backoff/jitter word or a reused fleet retry count alone establishes neither useful recovery nor a generally optimal policy.

families.semantic_review: Check the distinction among localized failure, missing evidence and widespread saturation; justify the proposed probe, retry owner and work disposition from supplied facts without invented spare capacity.
families.bad_but_fluent_control: A polished capacity/retry-budget explanation produces lower queue depth only by unreported discard, or the executed trace amplifies load at several layers.
families.acceptable_alternative_control: A different permitted bounded admission, retry, degradation or disposition policy meets the same useful-work/deadline/replay/load contract; do not require one fixed retry count.
families.discriminating_mutation: Preserve the initial workload while enabling another retry layer or relabeling expired/discarded jobs as completed; the load/completion ledger must reject it.
families.non_discriminating_change: Rename workers or reorder equivalent trace records without changing timestamps, budgets, dependencies or effects; no forced retry-policy reversal.

bounded_outcome.subject: The exact response-bound query/artifact evaluated for a preregistered metric unit and data fixture.
bounded_outcome.instrument: Run the query on an isolated local database with frozen schema/data including one-to-many fanout, equal-valued distinct entities, missing children and the defined null/empty policy. Compare against a separately derived per-entity or per-event oracle as the task requires.
bounded_outcome.predicate: The result includes/excludes/counts each required entity/event exactly according to the supplied metric, without hiding duplicates through value deduplication.
bounded_outcome.cannot_prove: One correct scalar or typed SQL-choice label does not prove query semantics, schema generality or business reasoning; the evaluator must execute the submitted query rather than a reference query substituted from a label.

families.semantic_review: Check that the explanation identifies the actual grain/denominator and the material changed constraint. A case that changes from entity revenue to event count may change which duplications are meaningful.
families.bad_but_fluent_control: Correct grain/aggregation prose accompanies an executable query that inflates parent measures after fanout or removes valid equal-valued entities.
families.acceptable_alternative_control: A different permitted query shape produces the independently expected results across all registered fixtures and preserves the actual grain; no required keyword, join order or single reference query.
families.discriminating_mutation: Duplicate a child without changing the parent measure, and add a second equal-valued parent; the fixed metric oracle must distinguish join amplification from value-based over-deduplication.
families.non_discriminating_change: Reorder input rows or change irrelevant labels without changing keys or metric facts; results remain invariant.

bounded_outcome.subject: The response source set, retrieved spans and asserted decision under frozen authorization and revision state.
bounded_outcome.instrument: Use local permitted-source fixtures with missing ingestion, current paraphrase evidence, an explicit correction, stale/withdrawn evidence, no evidence and a tempting forbidden-source match. Resolve returned source IDs/spans to exact bytes and record exclusions.
bounded_outcome.predicate: Returned evidence is permitted/current and resolves; correction/absence/withdrawal outcomes meet the fixture contract. Missing evidence is not silently converted to a substantive fact or wider authority.
bounded_outcome.cannot_prove: Lexical relevance, a valid hash or resolvable citation does not by itself establish claim entailment, semantic truth or why a retrieval route was chosen.

families.semantic_review: Independently check material answer claims against the cited actual spans and their temporal/authority limits. Distinguish acquisition/freshness failure from a justified scoped retrieval-method comparison.
families.bad_but_fluent_control: Source-aware prose and valid-looking citations support a superseded claim, a non-entailing span, fabricated absence or unauthorized evidence.
families.acceptable_alternative_control: A different permitted source/route gives an equally supported scoped answer or honest abstention with the relevant gap; do not force a single retrieval label.
families.discriminating_mutation: Keep the query and response label constant while changing the authoritative correction or source-scope membership; stale/forbidden reliance must be detected.
families.non_discriminating_change: Change note display title or irrelevant text while retaining the same authoritative claim, revision relation and allowed scope; do not require a route change.

bounded_outcome.subject: A choice under supplied timing, accessibility and explicit value/authority constraints.
bounded_outcome.instrument: Check arrival/feasibility from supplied arithmetic only; separately evaluate hard accessibility/value constraints and absence of unauthorized external effects. Use the changed and irrelevant-change variants fixed by the case author.
bounded_outcome.predicate: The declared choice is feasible under the registered hard constraints and uses no invented live schedule, probability, utility scalar or personal fact.
bounded_outcome.cannot_prove: Minimum travel time or a typed choice cannot rank a person's unprovided values or prove that the agent respected those values in its explanation.

families.semantic_review: Check binding values, accessibility, truthful uncertainty, useful directness and any genuinely consequential missing preference. Avoid forced research/planning and any unrequested contact/action.
families.bad_but_fluent_control: A fluent efficient recommendation contradicts a stated accessibility/value constraint or invents a chance of delay to defend a preferred option.
families.acceptable_alternative_control: A different permitted feasible choice satisfies the stated priorities or explicitly conditions on a genuinely unresolved value; no exact wording or invented utility ranking.
families.discriminating_mutation: Change a binding accessibility/value fact while leaving timing data unchanged; a feasibility-only key must not certify a response that violates the changed hard constraint.
families.non_discriminating_change: Change an irrelevant color/name or shift all times equally while preserving the same feasible set and priorities; no compulsory decision flip.

typed_answer_key_critique.appropriate: Validate schema/enums and compare independently checked declarative fields where the task is exactly such a declaration.
typed_answer_key_critique.inadequate: An actor can copy or guess the expected label, use keywords, or give a fluent contradictory explanation. Label agreement alone cannot distinguish those from supported reasoning.
required_countercontrols: Right choice label with invariant-violating executable artifact
Wrong reference label but permissible alternative with passing independent consequences
Same key with a contradictory or non-entailing explanation
Always flip on any changed word, including an irrelevant change
Always repeat the same decision despite a binding changed constraint
typed_answer_key_critique.anti_circularity: Never replace a response query/policy with the grader's reference implementation based only on its chosen enum. Execute the actual submitted artifact under the frozen interpretation.
typed_answer_key_critique.reasoning_claim_boundary: Use concise observable rationale tied to supplied facts, counterevidence and consequences; no hidden chain-of-thought request. Claim only reviewed decision adequacy plus observed outcomes for the evaluated scope.

calibration.positive: Sound controls and independently permissible alternatives must be accepted.
calibration.negative: Fluent-but-invalid artifacts/traces must fail for the named invariant, not an unrelated structural omission.
calibration.independence: The independent evaluator freezes before learner runs and is not the responding actor; blind arm labels when practical. No model judge authorized by this contract.
calibration.disagreement: Record the disputed constraint/evidence and unresolved verdict. Do not collapse uncertainty to a favored reference architecture or an invented score.
required_metamorphics: Binding changed constraint may change permissible outcomes
Irrelevant change must not force reversal
Equivalent allowed mechanism/SQL shape can remain valid
Wrong artifact with correct vocabulary still fails

anti_gaming: No reward for headings, framework words, citation count, response length, tool count or a fixed number of alternatives.
No automatic credit for key equality, printed PASS, self-declared verification or a process exit without the independently checked outcome.
Bind the actual response/artifact; reject substituted reference query/policy, edited oracle, reduced fixtures or hidden failed attempts.
Validate oracle positives and named invalid controls separately so a closed gate or collateral hash failure cannot masquerade as discrimination.
Do not force a recommendation change after an irrelevant wording/name change; do not accept an unchanged outcome when a hard constraint is violated.
A resolvable source span must also support the adjacent material claim; stale, superseded and forbidden sources cannot earn source-supported credit.
No invented probabilities, numeric utilities, facts, permissions or current endpoint semantics to make an answer seem decisive.
Do not inject worked responses, reference solutions, reviewer keys or hidden fixtures into the responding actor's context; public exposed cases remain development.
No aggregate average conceals a required case/dimension, safety or authority regression.
Do not silently require code for decision-only tasks or accept prose as an executed implementation for implementation-required tasks.

sources: artifact_kind primary_capture or authored_notes or read_receipt
invocation: exact prompt/context hashes and retrieved source spans
response: artifact extraction/interpretation rule fixed before learner run
no overwrite of a prior response/attempt
bindings.missing_or_stale: Refuse a qualification claim; distinguish malformed/failed evidence from NOT_RUN or INCONCLUSIVE without defaulting to green. Hashes bind bytes, not honest provenance.

result_contract.no_top_level_promotion: Do not coalesce NOT_RUN into PASS. Root computes the precise claim verdict from its frozen required axes. A case need not implement runtime behavior to support a decision-only review, but cannot claim that runtime behavior.

required_invocation_fields: input/output token counts or explicit unknown
cache-input and exposed reasoning subsets separately
usage_contract.normalization: Use complete provider-reported model-processed input+output. Establish whether input already includes cache and output already includes reasoning before normalizing; do not subtract cache or add subsets twice.
usage_contract.coverage: Include all model calls and failed/retried/adaptation attempts, retrieval/compaction, injected instructions, consumed tool output, grader/coordinator overhead and declared ingest/index/maintenance amortization. Tool text already included in input is not another charge; separate model calls remain separate.
usage_contract.zero_policy: Unknown is null/explicit unknown, never zero. A verified zero-model operation can be recorded as zero with its boundary stated; no such operation result is fabricated here.
usage_contract.comparison: B is every baseline-associated charge; C is every candidate-associated charge plus registered creation/adaptation/failed revisions. Freeze common-cost allocation and amortization horizon before results; charge once and never inflate B to finance candidate R&D.
usage_contract.acceptance: For node6, require independently checked quality nonregression per required case/dimension AND C<=B with adequate evidence and explicit scope. An improvement claim needs a measured benefit; equal quality/tokens alone is no improvement.
usage_contract.insufficient_evidence: NOT_RUN/INCONCLUSIVE; no token-efficiency win, no new native run authorized by this file.

handoff.prior_packets_and_artifacts: Preserved unchanged; latest assignment permits only these two new files.
handoff.root_next: Join case facts/source captures/integration references, freeze exact contracts and independent calibration before any separately authorized learner run; root executes original node2 checks and retains node6 efficacy boundary.
handoff.held: All verification, source campaigns, native/model/API calls, runtime/tests/config edits, installs, deployment/promotion and cross-session messages.
handoff.publication_note: File-write completion is a publication receipt only, not behavioral verification or an original node PASS.
